profile.headline: Technical Lead & Senior Software Engineer @ Microsoft CoreAI | Schulich Leader ‘16 | Vector, Semantic, Agentic, Graph Search
profile.summary:
👋 Hi! I'm a Technical Lead and Senior Software Engineer at Microsoft Azure Foundry IQ AI Knowledge, building the retrieval layer that grounds enterprise AI in the right knowledge — at billion-document scale. I serve as the technical lead for a team of 6 engineers and scientists on a novel diversity-aware vector search algorithm based on state-of-the-art research.

🤖 GitHub: github.com/robertklee
👀 Chat with me: robertkl.com

I built significant portions of our vector search and quantization stack all the way to GA: 8–32× cost savings and up to 20× lower latency through binary and scalar quantization with SIMD-accelerated distance computation. Along the way I've worked at tough problems at the intersection of information retrieval, agents, vector search, MCP, and knowledge graphs.

Today, my focus is agentic retrieval: grounding LLM agents and multi-agent workflows in governed enterprise knowledge. Agents decompose questions and chain queries, so a weak result early on quietly corrupts everything after it — and retrieval quality is silent. Most of my work now is bridging research and production: taking a problem with no natural boundary, defining criteria for a system that's nondeterministic, rebuilding research algorithms to survive the scale, durability, online updates, and concurrency realities of a highly-available production distributed system.

Before Microsoft: a B.Eng in Electrical & Computer Engineering with a 97% GPA, and 20+ scholarships and awards worth over $100,000 — including the Schulich Leader Scholarship (one of 50 awarded nationally), a Governor General's Academic Medal, and a national champion in Michael Smith Science Challenge with a record score.

Outside the code, I build communities: a 200+ person conference from vision to reality, a seniors' technology program grown to 180+ volunteers and 650+ participants, and industry mentorship for requirements engineering students at the University of Victoria.

My expertise includes:

• Technical excellence in software engineering: 12+ years in C, C++, C#, Python, Java, TypeScript.

• Strong background in machine learning and computer vision, with notable projects in semantic road segmentation, monocular depth estimation, and human pose estimation, achieving competitive results within tight timelines.

• Experience in embedded, firmware and hardware: assembly, FPGAs, low-level code features like interrupts, I2C/SPI interfaces, I/O & control registers. Altium, PCB design & testing, soldering, analog circuits, communication protocols, control systems, DSP, FFT, oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer & Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Tech lead (6 engineers and scientists) on technical vision and end-to-end delivery of novel vector-search diversity capability. Strengthens vector search by reducing homogeneity via topical diversity, improving grounding for complex, corpus-spanning queries or within e-commerce or recommendation systems.
	- Rearchitected a SOTA research algorithm into production by analyzing and rethinking its algorithm & architecture for distributed systems execution while preserving its core strengths; drove 7 targeted innovations to serve extreme requirements of hyperscalability, durability, corpus drift, availability, and performance.
	- Ownership: from leadership buy-in to cross-org alignment, greenfield architecture design and technical investment decisions.
	- Designed a new robust, maintainable architecture through system-wide decisions in scalability, recovery, and extensibility. Resolved critical design tradeoffs, consolidated infrastructure responsibilities into a shared system core, decoupled shared mechanisms to unlock 3 engineers’ parallel execution.
	- Drove profiling-led optimizations across compute kernels and execution paths, combining SIMD acceleration with improved allocation efficiency, optimized data movement, and tighter control of intermediate-state lifetimes. Improved latency by 4.68x and reduced memory by 85.6% before shipping.

- Led research-to-prod for agentic-retrieval filter and boost generation. Set the technical direction by reformulating an unbounded problem into a reduced operator set — leveraging production analysis to demonstrate utility on real workloads; brought both teams to consensus.
- Integrated Azure AI Search retrieval into agents - grounding them with governed, indexed enterprise knowledge across tools, multi-agent orchestration, and RAG.
- Architected a new benchmarking system to profile highly variable agentic-retrieval workloads to establish the serverless billing formula for agentic retrieval; optimized memory by 80% on key paths.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Drove vector storage, quantization, and relevance for Azure AI Search's vector retrieval engine, spanning billion-vector scale.

- Drove vector quantization from Public Preview through to GA - now widely adopted by customers - delivering 8-32x cost savings and up to 20x latency reduction through binary vectors, scalar and binary quantization, and SIMD-accelerated distance computation.
- Strengthened the relevance stack by designing hybrid-search subscore fusion and score thresholding to improve result quality across blended vector and keyword retrieval.
- Designed and shipped a data-driven quota-enforcement mechanism for HNSW indexes tied to physical resource utilization, cutting limit overshoot by 100x through cross-team design collaboration.
- Owned end-to-end delivery of an extensible facet-aggregation engine from spec, building a custom lexer-parser-evaluator that applies BNF grammar, the shunting-yard algorithm, and Reverse Polish Notation to parse, simplify, and validate expressions - backed by extensive A/B test coverage.
- Hardened the vector search engine with a new test suite that caught a critical bug in a new quantization algorithm before release.
- Acted as a subject-matter expert and key reviewer - root-causing deeply technical production incidents across teams to rapidly restore customer service and drive durable fixes, while raising reliability through rigorous review of distributed-systems and vector-algorithm changes.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:

- Modernized a core telemetry-database table through a phased, zero-downtime migration that preserved data integrity and delivered a 50-100x query speedup.

• Connected designers, engineers, and program managers to identify scope of work and feature set.

positions.description:

• Built image processing pipeline, DevOps Continuous Integration, iOS share extension, and integration of TensorFlow Android binding library. Team expert on Git version control.
• Clearly documented code to reduce code debt and increase readability; discussed data structures and algorithms with team before implementation to ensure appropriate choices.
• Programmed in C# backend, iOS storyboard frontend.
• Project available open-source at: https://github.com/Microsoft/Mobile-Chest-X-Ray-Analysis

Talks from Sam Altman, Satya Nadella, Andrej Karpathy, Fei-Fei Li, and others covered frontier model development, agents, and the path from research to product.

projects.title: Human Pose Estimation using Deep Neural Networks
projects.description:
Project and Team Lead for a student team to develop a deep neural network for human pose estimation (HPE) on the COCO-2017 dataset. 

Check it out here: https://share.streamlit.io/robertklee/coco-human-pose/main/human_pose_app.py

I architected our cloud training pipeline, model architecture, and data augmentation method. I led work in model visualization and deployment. 

Our model achieves very good performance on almost all images, provided the person is relatively centered and about 60-95% of the vertical image height (these are limitations we chose due to the tight time constraints of the project). It struggles in some extremely difficult images, typically with highly overlapped people or heavily occluded joints. 

The model performs single-person single-image 2D HPE with a kinematic model and a heatmap-based approach for joint prediction rather than a regression on joint locations. The model was trained from scratch with random weight initializations, and our team developed much of the plumbing from scratch as well.

projects.title: Road Segmentation Machine Learning Project on KITTI ROAD dataset
projects.description:
- Successfully trained a U-Net CNN on the KITTI Road dataset using Keras, achieving up to 99.1% F1 score and 91% in the worst case.
- Designed and implemented the full training pipeline, including data generator, training/testing scripts, custom loss functions, and cloud training setup using Google Colab.
- Tuned hyperparameters and used data augmentation to improve model generalization under varied conditions.
- Researched and designed the network architecture by analyzing state-of-the-art computer vision literature.
- Resolved architectural and training bugs in the decoder and segmentation logic to ensure stable performance.
- Evaluated model using pixel-based metrics and addressed edge cases like shadows, occlusions, and road artifacts.
